brief:
Rapper Macklemore says he was removed from Ed Sheeran's US tour because of his pro-Palestinian stance, Al Jazeera English reported. Macklemore had been scheduled to open dates on the tour but was cut from the lineup, according to the artist's account.

The removal marks a notable instance of an artist facing professional consequences tied to public positions on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Macklemore has been vocal in expressing solidarity with Palestinians amid the ongoing regional tensions.
dek: Macklemore says he was dropped from Ed Sheeran’s US tour over his pro-Palestinian stance.
title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran tour over Palestine support
